QuestionStmt.S: Find molar mass of nonvolatile solute when 20 g of it dissolved in 200 g water at 300 K. [Relative lowering of vapour pressure = 0.02]

Solution.S:
Given:
Mass of solute w₂ = 20 g
Mass of solvent (water) w₁ = 200 g
Relative lowering Δp/p⁰ = 0.02
Molar mass of water M₁ = 18 g/mol

For dilute solutions:
Δp/p⁰ ≈ n₂/n₁ = (w₂/M₂) / (w₁/M₁) = (w₂ × M₁) / (w₁ × M₂)

Substitute values:
0.02 = (20 × 18) / (200 × M₂) = 360 / (200 × M₂)

Rearrange:
0.02 × 200 × M₂ = 360
4 × M₂ = 360
M₂ = 360 / 4 = 90 g/mol

Thus, the correct option is C: 90 g mol⁻¹
